Brakka.content: DM: Session 3 - the Lantern House in Varrow. Night, river fog. The Toll King's ledger said his tolls were sold here. The Lantern House is a floating auction hall of paper lanterns; each lantern holds a bought secret or toll. Tonight's lot: "the names of every traveller who crossed the Ember Road this year" - the Toll King's 31 dead among them. Masked bidders murmur; the auctioneer, a smiling gnome called Madam Wisp, has four hired blades at the doors. Steve the ox is tied on the dock outside. Tovin's crown hums louder near the lanterns. Bidding opens at 50 gold. What do you do?

"Keep them inside. Don't let any leave."

"Wick, Tovin, Maren. Luz behind us all."

"Keep the exits covered, but the lanterns stay. They don't touch them."

[Shieldwall: Bottleneck activation]

DM (results): Wick's wink fails (Deception 7) - Madam Wisp sees him licking a lot: "Touching the lots costs the lot's price, dear." Luz's Public Edict lands: the nearest guard goes pale and drops his sword, backing to the wall. Maren's bees slip out unseen among the lanterns (Stealth 16). Tovin's honest bid falls flat, but his bluffed 200 gold (money he doesn't have) wins the lot (Deception 17) - "Sold!" Brakka notices (Perception 13) the lanterns hang on oil-soaked cords and the fourth "blade" is a mage.
Then Wisp's steward whispers in her ear; her smile goes cold: "Your purse is empty, Toll King's heir." She snaps her fingers. The lanterns flare; the lot lantern holding the 31 names starts to burn; three blades and the mage close in; the dock gangplank begins to lift - Steve bellows outside. FIGHT, round 1. What do you do?

"I said, 'Keep them inside.'"

"Back to the wall, Luz."

"Take the lantern, Wick."

"Mage, you're dead. Get your hands off it."

[Shieldwall: Bottleneck activation]

DM (results): Brakka holds the only aisle and cuts the mage (7). Wick's dagger takes a blade in the throat-guard (15) - he drops to one knee. Steve smashes the door off its hinges and tramples a second blade (Oxwhip, 14) - Wick's ox is a legend. Parsnip refuses to go near the fire, but Maren's Thorn Lash wraps the third blade (6, Restrained). Tovin and Luz both lunge for the burning lantern - Tovin gets it first (13 vs 12) and tucks it, smoking, under his cloak; his threat to the blades falls flat. The mage's Fire Bolt hits Tovin full in the chest (18 fire) - he is badly burned and nearly down. A blade scratches Maren (3).
Now: the kneeling blade Wick hit throws down his sword: "I yield! I yield!" - he is right at Tovin's feet. The mage is backing toward a side door with Madam Wisp. The lanterns overhead are catching one by one. Round 2. What do you do?

"Mage. You're dead."

"Wick. Keep the lane clear."

"Luz. Tovin. Be ready."

[Shieldwall: Bottleneck activation]

[Move to attack the mage, Longsword vs. Mage's Dagger]

DM (results): Brakka's blade bites the mage again (5). Wick's leap onto the mage's back misses - he sprawls on the planks - but his taunt rattles the mage anyway. Luz's threat does not move him; Madam Wisp and the mage slip out a side door into the fog. Tovin presses the burning lantern to the yielded blade's chest (3 fire) and the man, sobbing, agrees to show the way out; Maren kneels and heals that same blade's wounds (Field Triage, 8) while he shows you a hidden hatch. You all drop through it onto a fishing barge as the Lantern House goes up in flames behind you. Steve swims after the barge. You have the lot: a scorched lantern holding the names of the 31.
DOWNTIME - three days in Varrow while Tovin's burns heal. The city is a canal town of fishmongers, a Dawn Mother chapel, dice dens, a flower market, a bathhouse, and a notice board with a new bounty: "Madam Wisp, for arson and fraud". What does your character spend the three days doing? Give 2-3 things.

- Sharpen sword and inspect shield for damage.
- Spend time on the docks with Steve, checking the waters for threats.
- Practice shieldwall techniques with the ox.
[Animal Handling]

I glance at Luz, her distrust a palpable thing. "This is necessary, Luz. For the party. For the truth." I turn back to Madam Wisp, my voice dropping to a conspiratorial whisper. "I'll even throw in a tale, a secret of my own. 200 gold." [Deception]
